role: XCTest suite pinning call-shape privacy controls: PasteboardWriter options carry .localOnly and a 60-s expiry unless preserveClipboardForPaste is on; no source file outside PasteboardWriter.swift references UIPasteboard.general in code; and the assistant stream buffer's closing flush is written inside a `defer`.
types: PrivacyControlsTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase with option assertions and source-tree text scans

flags.text: The 'nothing writes to the pasteboard directly' scan only looks for the literal 'UIPasteboard.general'. Views that enable system text selection let the user's Copy menu write to the Universal Clipboard without .localOnly or expiry, which the scan cannot see — e.g. the LLM prompt audit bodies (LLMPromptAuditView.swift:231) and the archive index diagnostics (ExportAndArchiveViews.swift:546).

testTheStreamBufferFlushIsDeferred is a text match on 'buffer.flush(force: true' in one hard-coded file path; renaming the variable, moving the call, or wrapping the defer over two lines fails or bypasses it without any behaviour change.

units.does: With preserveClipboardForPaste false asserts an expirationDate 50–60 s ahead; with it true asserts no expiry; restores the original setting.
